notes: The character map is described by the incidence matrix 1_Σ, followed by a product over selected embeddings, a restriction to the real subfield and factorization through S_K^0. “Duaux” is recovered at the beginning, and the insertion is abbreviated “comp.ble : G”. The prose literally says “défini par T_E”; that clear label is preserved. Check 150.N1: the product expression pulls the i-th coordinate character back to the sum Σ_j 1_Σ(i,j)e_j, giving the written lattice map Z^{I_E}→Z^{I_K}. This explicit map relates the prose to ψ_Σ; it does not justify replacing the written T_E. The trial equality ψ_Σ(x)^2=N_K is struck and unfinished, and has not been treated as a live theorem. The final factorization claim was transcribed without a separate proof check. Archive number 149.
